program:
PARAMS = {
    "gbw":       (4.0e5, 2.0e5, 8.0e5),     # loop GBW target [Hz] (sets T(1k) -> PSRR)
    "cc":        (25e-12, 10e-12, 60e-12),  # Ahuja compensation cap vout -> cascode source
    "ihalf":     (2.5e-6, 1.0e-6, 5.0e-6),  # half tail current of diff pair
    "gmid_in":   (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),        # diff pair gm/Id
    "idiv":      (15e-6, 8e-6, 25e-6),      # feedback divider current (also min pass bias)
    "vcm":       (0.25, 0.20, 0.33),        # divided-down comparison voltage (fb = vrs = vcm)
    "gmid_pass": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),         # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (tt)
    "L_pass":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.40),
    "L_mir":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),           # mirror lengths (systematic offset)
    "vcas":      (0.30, 0.20, 0.40),        # nfet cascode headroom drop (IREF*R)
}

def _vsg(lt, dev, W, L, Id, vds):
    """Binary-search |Vgs| that gives Id at (W,L,vds). Returns None on failure."""
    try:
        lo, hi = 0.15, 1.95
        for _ in range(45):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lt.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    except Exception:
        return None

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vo   = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    CL   = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    vcm  = p["vcm"]
    beta = vcm / vo
    Ih   = p["ihalf"]
    Lm   = p["L_mir"]
    gmn, gmp = 14.0, 14.0          # mirror densities (moderate inversion, low vdsat)
    Ib1  = 2.5e-6                  # pfet bias branch
    vcp  = 0.25                    # pfet cascode headroom drop
    idiv = p["idiv"]
    cc   = p["cc"]

    # ---------------- diff pair & output-branch scaling ----------------
    mi = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, Ih, vds=0.6)
    Gm_req = 2 * PI * p["gbw"] * cc / beta
    k  = min(max(Gm_req / mi.gm, 2.0), 12.0)
    Io = k * Ih                                 # output branch current
    Gm = k * mi.gm

    # ---------------- mirrors (same L, same gm/Id, same vds -> W ~ I) ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmn, Lm, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmn, Lm, Ib1,  vds=0.6)
    mna = lut.size("n", gmn, Lm, Ih,   vds=0.6)
    m3  = lut.size("n", gmn, Lm, Io,   vds=0.6)
    mpb = lut.size("p", gmp, Lm, Ib1,  vds=0.6)
    mpt = lut.size("p", gmp, Lm, 2*Ih, vds=0.6)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmp, Lm, Ih,   vds=0.6)
    mpo = lut.size("p", gmp, Lm, Io,   vds=0.6)
    # cascodes (Ahuja buffer = mpc: its gm sets buffer pole gm/Cc)
    mnc = lut.size("n", 18.0, 0.5, Io, vds=0.5, vsb=p["vcas"])
    mpc = lut.size("p", 16.0, 0.5, Io, vds=0.5)

    # ---------------- pass device with worst-case headroom check ----------
    Lp = p["L_pass"]
    Ipass = imax + idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, Ipass, vds=0.42)
    W = mp.W
    y_min = p["vcas"] + 0.12
    vsg_max = 1.62 - y_min - 0.04
    for _ in range(14):
        worst = 0.0
        for cor in ("ss", "fs"):
            try:
                v = _vsg(lut.at(cor, -40), "p", W, Lp, Ipass, 0.42)
            except Exception:
                v = None
            if v is not None:
                worst = max(worst, v)
        if worst <= vsg_max or W >= 4800:
            break
        W *= 1.2
    W = min(W, 4800.0)

    # small-signal of pass at max & min load (tt)
    try:
        vg_max = _vsg(lut, "p", W, Lp, Ipass, 0.42)
        omax = lut.op("p", W, Lp, vg_max, 0.42)
        gm_pmax, gds_pmax, Cg = omax["gm"], omax["gds"], omax["cgg"]
        vg_min = _vsg(lut, "p", W, Lp, imin + idiv, 0.6)
        omin = lut.op("p", W, Lp, vg_min, 0.6)
        gm_pmin, gds_pmin = omin["gm"], omin["gds"]
    except Exception:
        gm_pmax, gds_pmax, Cg = mp.gm * W / mp.W, mp.gds * W / mp.W, mp.cgg * W / mp.W
        gm_pmin, gds_pmin = (imin + idiv) * 18.0, (imin + idiv) * 18.0 / 8.0
    C1 = Cg + 0.15e-12

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> R -> nfet diode ; ibias node = Vgs + vcas = nfet cascode gate
    n.R("RNC", "ibias", "nb", p["vcas"] / iref)
    n.dev("MB0", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pc", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    n.R("RPC", "pb", "pc", vcp / Ib1)               # pc = pb - vcp : pfet cascode gate
    # reference divider (from vref) and feedback divider
    rr = 600e3
    n.R("RA", "vref", "vrs", rr * (vref - vcm) / vref)
    n.R("RB", "vrs", "vss", rr * vcm / vref)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", (vo - vcm) / idiv)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", vcm / idiv)
    # front-end: PMOS diff pair (bulk = own common source), diode loads
    n.dev("MPT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpt)
    n.dev("MA", "da", "vrs", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("MB", "db", "fb",  "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("MNA", "da", "da", "vss", "vss", mna)
    n.dev("MNB", "db", "db", "vss", "vss", mna)
    # vref-side current -> pfet mirror (x k) -> cascode -> gate y (pull-up)
    n.dev("MNA2", "pd", "da", "vss", "vss", mna)
    n.dev("MPD", "pd", "pd", "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MPO", "sc", "pd", "vin", "vin", mpo)
    n.dev("MPC", "y", "pc", "sc", "sc", mpc)
    # fb-side current -> nfet mirror (x k) -> cascode -> gate y (pull-down)
    n.dev("MN3", "sn", "db", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("MNC", "y", "ibias", "sn", "vss", mnc)
    # Ahuja compensation: vout -> low-Z cascode source
    n.C("CC", "vout", "sc", cc)
    # pass device
    n.M("MPASS", "vout", "y", "vin", "vin", "pfet", W, Lp)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    gbw  = beta * Gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    p2   = gm_pmin * cc / (2 * PI * C1 * CL)          # Ahuja-split output pole (min load)
    pbuf = mpc.gm / (2 * PI * cc)                     # current-buffer pole
    pm   = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pbuf)) - 3
    Ry   = 1.0 / (m3.gds * mnc.gds / mnc.gm + mpo.gds * mpc.gds / mpc.gm)
    Gdiv = idiv / vo
    T0   = beta * Gm * Ry * gm_pmax / (gds_pmax + Gdiv)
    load_reg = (1.0 / (gds_pmax + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0) + 0.05
    line_reg = (gds_pmax / (gds_pmax + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0) + 3e-4
    psrr = db(1 + gbw / 1e3)
    iq = iref + Ib1 + 2 * Ih + Ih + Io + idiv
    # undershoot: gate must move ~0.2 V with ~Io pull (Ahuja + mirror) during 100 ns ramp
    t_resp = 25e-9 + C1 * 0.2 / max(Io, 1e-6)
    t_resp = min(t_resp, 100e-9)
    undershoot = 0.5 * (imax * t_resp / 100e-9) * t_resp / CL + 0.03
    off_in = 0.01 * Io / Gm                            # ~1% residual mirror mismatch
    vout_err = 100 * off_in / beta / vo + 0.1

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 1e-3,
        "gbw_hz": gbw, "p2_min_hz": p2, "pbuf_hz": pbuf, "pm_deg": pm,
        "k_mirror": k, "W_pass_um": W, "T0_maxload": T0,
    }

events.topology: PMOS-pass LDO with a current-mirror OTA (PMOS input pair at a 0.25 V divided-down CM, k-scaled cascoded output) and Ahuja (cascode-node) compensation from vout
